description:
The pages AI engines cite where the brand's URL isn't cited — "best X" listicles, directories and marketplaces, review sites, forum threads, news, videos, competitors' own pages — from the site's audits, as outreach targets: each page typed, checked for whether it already names or links the brand, ranked by leverage, with one next step (pitch the listicle's author, submit the listing, collect reviews, answer the thread, counter a competitor's page). Asks no engine.

Billing: 10¢ per site per 24h; repeats and other filters on the site that day are free (charged_cents 0). Not billed when nothing in scope was lost (no_data, nothing_lost, no_sources) or on an error.

When to call: after get_audit shows lost prompts, or when the user asks where to get listed or mentioned, which lists or directories to pitch, or why AI cites other sites.

Inputs: site_id (list_sites); audit_id — optional, one audit instead of the window; window_days — default 90 (7–365); prompt — only prompts containing this text; engines; types — only these page types; limit — default 15 (1–40).

Returns { scope, summary: {answered_cells, lost_cells, prompts_lost, cited_pages, by_type, pages_checked, brand_absent_on}, targets: [{rank, url, host, type, competitor, brand_on_page, title, author, updated, submit_url, pages_on_host?, lost_prompts, lost_cells, engines, example_prompts, last_seen, leverage, why, next_step: {action, detail, tool?, args?}}], more_targets, notes, charged_cents }. type: listicle | review_site | directory | forum | news | article | video | social | company_page | docs | reference | other. brand_on_page: linked | mentioned | absent | unknown | not_checked (only the top 15 pages are fetched). A directory's pages count as one target per host.

Outreach is the user's call: present the targets, draft a pitch only when asked, save the list they pick with update_site_brief.

Example: { site_id: "…", types: ["listicle", "directory"] }

audit_id.description: Read only this audit (list_sites' latest_audit.audit_id). Omit for every audit in the window.

window_days.description: Days of audit history to read, default 90. Ignored with audit_id.

name: find_citation_sources
title: Find the pages AI engines cite instead of the brand, as outreach targets
